name: Buttress
body:
School transmutation; Level sorcerer/wizard 2

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target one object up to 1 cubic ft./level
Duration 1 minute/level
Saving Throw Will negates (object); Spell Resistance yes (object)

DESCRIPTION

This spell strengthens the object in question, making it less likely to break — doubling the object’s hit points and increasing its hardness by 5.

This is most often used on lances to keep them from shattering.
